item.title: Daniss Jenkins puts up career-high 30 points as Pistons end Lakers' 9-game win streak, 113-110
item.description: Daniss Jenkins scored a career-high 30 points, including six in the final 34 seconds, and the Detroit Pistons ended the Los Angeles Lakers' nine-game win streak with a 113-110 victory.

item.title: Hawks get double-digit scoring from 8 players and beat Grizzlies 146-107
item.description: Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 26 points and eight Atlanta players scored in double figures as the Hawks routed the Memphis Grizzlies 146-107 on Monday night.

item.title: Stephen Curry will participate in play-in tourney for Warriors if he's able, coach Steve Kerr says
item.description: Golden State coach Steve Kerr says Stephen Curry will be available for the play-in tournament if his ailing right knee allows.

item.title: Edwards, Okot power top-seed South Carolina into Sweet 16 with 101-61 victory over USC
item.description: Joyce Edwards had 23 points and 10 rebounds, Madina Okot added her 22nd double-double this season with 15 points and 15 rebounds, and top-seeded South Carolina advanced to its 12th straight Sweet 16 with a 101-61 victory over ninth-seeded Southern California in the women's NCAA Tournament.

item.title: Siakam scores 37 as Pacers end record 16-game slide with 128-126 victory at Orlando
item.description: Pascal Siakam scored 37 points and blocked Paolo Banchero's attempted layup in the final seconds to help the Indiana Pacers end their franchise-record 16-game losing streak with a 128-126 win over the Orlando Magic.

item.title: Rangers muster just nine shots on goal in loss to Senators
item.description: Franklin Square native Shane Pinto scored one of the Senators' two goals.

item.title: Bulls race to 20-point lead in 1st quarter, hang on to beat the Rockets 132-124
item.description: Matas Buzelis' layup in the final seconds put Chicago ahead to stay and Collin Sexton came off the bench to score 25 points as the Chicago Bulls beat the Houston Rockets 132-124.

item.title: A 1,000-year-old cliff-top temple lies battered after Cambodia-Thailand border clashes
item.description: Cambodia says fighting with Thailand has left the Preah Vihear temple badly damaged and too dangerous for visitors.

item.title: Dodgers pitcher Roki Sasaki struggles again in exhibition start against the Angels
item.description: Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Roki Sasaki is still struggling with the regular season approaching.

item.title: Theegala finds a fairway and leads LA to late victory over Jupiter for 1-0 lead in TGL final
item.description: Sahith Theegala couldn't find a fairway until it mattered for Los Angeles.
